status: mechanically extracted — hooks not yet scoped/typed in kernel. Added opt-in voice-to-text on the seed field (toggleVoiceToText/startVoiceDictation/initVoiceToggleUI, all generic — not hardcoded to this field — in eravos-kernel.js): a checkbox reveals a mic button that dictates via the browser's own SpeechRecognition (Chrome/Edge/Safari; no server, nothing leaves the device). Off by default since it asks for mic permission. The lattice has no text entry of its own — buildLatticeData() only reads from Codex/Vault/Ruptures/etc. — so this feeds the lattice indirectly: whatever's dictated here becomes the seed generateMythos() turns into myth, and saveToVault()/sendToCodex() on that output is what actually lands in the lattice's word constellation.
